cr_data.provenance: (The Intimate Gallery, New York, NY); Leonard C. Hanna, Jr., Cleveland, Ohio, 1928 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Double entries Abiquiú Notebooks. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Big white Flower fills most of canvas. Black edge at bottom." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive date 1926. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1926 and 1927. Dated 1926 on basis of verso inscription and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
